# Draft:Kya Stewart

----
Kya Stewart is an actor best known for her roles in the US Sci-fi thriller Risen, Australian television show One Night and the Australian romantic drama Her Last Laugh starring Ana Thu Nguyen (Mortal Kombat 2) and Peter Thurnwald (XO Kitty).
She also starred in two films selected for Tropfest; Project Hourglass alongside Bob Morley (The 100), an official selection directed by Ben Mathews, and One More For Safety, directed by Kacey Baker as part of the Wildcard Competition. Both films premiered on February 22.
